==About==

A {{i|Crowberry Stalk}} can be boiled in a {{i|Clay Pot}} or {{i|Copper Pot}} for 3 hours to make {{i|Crowberry Pectin}}. Crowberry Pectin '''CANNOT''' be used for Gluttony.
